rule_basis: Provisional month-end snapshot: include only if start_date <= period end and end_date is null or >= period end.
Provisional inclusive end-date rule: a subscription ending on the snapshot date remains included through that date.
Provisional month-end snapshot: end_date after period end remains eligible at the snapshot.

scenario: Month after an on-month-end end date
rule_basis: Provisional inclusive end-date rule: the subscription is no longer active at a later snapshot.
Provisional day-grain snapshot: a subscription starting on the snapshot date is included.
Provisional month-end snapshot: start_date after period end is not yet eligible.
Provisional month-end snapshot: include the new subscription when active at period end; the reactivation event itself is not MRR.

scenario: Non-reactivation churn on month-end with positive refund
rule_basis: Assign event by churn_date; count a non-reactivation event in January. refund_amount_usd is not recurring MRR.

scenario: Non-reactivation churn one day after month-end
rule_basis: Assign event by churn_date; exclude a February event from January. refund_amount_usd is not recurring MRR.

scenario: Reactivation on month-end with positive refund
rule_basis: Count as a January reactivation and not as churn. refund_amount_usd is not recurring MRR.
Exclude from January event counts by churn_date; a reactivation event is not recurring MRR.

scenario: Earlier reactivation in a churn-then-reactivate sequence
rule_basis: Count the reactivation transition separately; it does not erase the earlier churn and its refund is not recurring MRR.
Count a subsequent non-reactivation event after reactivation as a candidate churn; refund_amount_usd is not recurring MRR.
